title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS REFLECT THE IDEOLOGY OF THEIR CREATORS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the moral assessment of political persons, which included a category for 'religious figure'. The analysis used 61 ideology tags, including 'Traditional Morality', to characterize the ideological stance of LLMs.
findings: LLMs from Russian organizations were relatively more favorable towards political persons tagged with 'Traditional Morality'. This tag was one of several used to map the ideological landscape, with religion being a minor component of the overall analysis.
